tools.name: maps_geocode
tools.description: Convert an address or landmark name to GPS coordinates (forward geocoding), or convert coordinates to an address (reverse geocoding). Use this for placing pins on maps or finding where a place is located.

address.description: Address or landmark to geocode, e.g. 'Tokyo Tower' or '1-1 Marunouchi, Tokyo'

tools.name: maps_search_places
tools.description: Search for places by text query like 'ramen restaurants in Shinjuku' or 'coffee shops near Tokyo Tower'. Returns place names, addresses, ratings, and IDs. Use this when the user asks for recommendations or wants to find places.

query.description: What to search for, e.g. 'sushi restaurants in Ginza'

latitude.description: Latitude to bias results near a location

longitude.description: Longitude to bias results near a location

radius.description: Search radius in meters, max 50000. Default: 5000

type.description: Place type filter: restaurant, hotel, cafe, tourist_attraction, etc.

tools.name: maps_place_details
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific place using its Google Place ID. Returns opening hours, phone number, website, reviews, and ratings. Use this after search to get more info about a place the user is interested in.

place_id.description: Google Place ID from a previous search result

fields.description: Specific fields to return. Fewer fields = lower API cost. Available: name, address, phone, website, rating, hours, reviews

tools.name: maps_directions
tools.description: Calculate a route between two places with travel time, distance, and step-by-step directions. Supports driving, walking, transit, and cycling. Use this when the user asks 'how to get from A to B' or when planning daily itinerary routes.

origin.description: Starting point — address, landmark name, or 'place_id:ChIJ...'

destination.description: End point — address, landmark name, or 'place_id:ChIJ...'

mode.description: Travel mode. Default: TRANSIT (best for city travel)

departure_time.description: ISO 8601 datetime for traffic-aware routing, e.g. '2026-04-10T09:00:00+09:00'

tools.name: maps_distance_matrix
tools.description: Calculate travel distances and times between multiple origins and destinations at once. Returns a matrix of all pairs. Use this to optimize itinerary order — find which places are closest to each other for efficient day planning.

origins.description: List of starting points (addresses or place_ids)

destinations.description: List of end points (addresses or place_ids)

tools.name: maps_timezone
tools.description: Get timezone information for a location by its coordinates. Returns timezone ID, name, and UTC offset. Use this to show local times in trip itineraries or convert between timezones for travel planning.

timestamp.description: Unix timestamp in seconds. Default: current time. Use specific dates to account for daylight saving.
